/* V10 mobile-first visual QA corrections */
.startup{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;align-items:center;gap:0}.startup>.art{height:auto;width:100%;max-height:390px;object-fit:contain;object-position:center bottom}.startup>.pad{min-width:0}.startup .actions{margin:10px 0}.startup .quote{font-size:13px}
.news-img{width:94px;height:68px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:10px;background:#0c263f;flex:0 0 94px}.event-list article{overflow:hidden}.event-list article>div{min-width:0}.modal.single{display:block;max-width:550px}.modal.single .copy{padding:25px}.modal .actions{align-items:stretch}.holding .chart{max-height:170px}
@media(max-width:850px){.startup{grid-template-columns:1fr}.startup>.art{max-height:240px;object-position:top center}.startup>.pad{order:0}.startup>.art{order:1}}
@media(max-width:560px){.startup>.pad{padding:13px}.startup>.art{max-height:175px}.startup .quote{display:none}.startup p{font-size:13px;margin:8px 0}.startup .actions .btn{min-height:49px}.intro{margin-bottom:9px}.intro p{margin-bottom:10px}.modal.single .copy{padding:16px}.news-img{width:75px;height:60px;flex-basis:75px}}
/* Desktop QA correction: prevent the fixed bottom navigation from covering NAV charts. */
@media(min-width:1024px){
 .app{padding-left:214px}
 .bottom{left:max(12px,calc((100vw - 1280px)/2 + 12px));top:260px;bottom:auto;transform:none;width:195px;grid-template-columns:1fr;border-radius:19px;padding:12px;gap:6px}
 .bottom button{flex-direction:row;gap:10px;justify-content:flex-start;text-align:left;font-size:13px;padding:13px 12px}
 .bottom button span{font-size:21px}
}
.launchbox{margin:0 0 15px;border-color:#ceaa64}.launchbox h2{font-size:21px;margin:8px 0}.launchbox .actions{margin:6px 0 0}.launchbox .btn.gold{font-size:15px;min-height:54px}.startup{margin:9px 0}.startup>.art{max-height:310px}
@media(max-width:560px){.launchbox{margin-top:9px}.launchbox .pad{padding:11px}.launchbox h2{font-size:18px;margin:4px 0 6px}.launchbox .actions{gap:5px}.launchbox .btn{padding:9px 10px;min-height:44px}.startup>.art{max-height:165px}.startup h2{font-size:17px}.startup .pad p{font-size:12px}.intro{margin-top:7px}}

/* V11 Premium: calm data, vibrant storytelling, accessible actions */
:root{--bg:#071624;--panel:#102c42;--panel2:#193b50;--gold:#efca83;--line:#2b5167;--muted:#afc5d1;--txt:#f7f5ee}
body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% -10%,#193e57 0,#091b2d 45%,#061421 90%);color:var(--txt)}
.app{max-width:1180px}
.head{background:#0b2336;border-color:#23455b;box-shadow:0 8px 28px #0003}
.brand .right{font-weight:700}
.rank{margin:10px 0}
.kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.kpis>div{background:#142f43;border:1px solid #315970;color:#f7f3e9;border-radius:13px;padding:11px 13px}
.kpis small{color:#a9c4d3;font-size:11px;font-weight:600}
.kpis b{color:#f6d697;font-size:clamp(17px,2.1vw,25px);margin-top:4px;word-break:normal}
.macro{margin-top:9px}
.macro>div{background:#10283d;border-color:#23445b;padding:8px 12px}
.news-ticker{margin-top:8px;background:#173346;border:1px solid #2d5465;color:#efc980;border-radius:11px;padding:10px 12px}
.news-ticker span{color:#e1e8e8;font-weight:500}
.status-details{background:transparent;border:0;margin-top:6px;padding:0}
.status-details>summary{color:#9bb4c5;font-size:11px;list-style:none;text-align:center;padding:8px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}
.status-details>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.status-details>summary span{color:#e9c780;margin-left:4px}
.status-details[open]{border-top:1px solid #23475b;padding-top:4px}
.minis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px}
.minis>div{background:#102b42;border-radius:11px;padding:10px;text-align:center}
.minis small{color:#a4bfcd;display:block;font-size:11px}
.minis b{display:block;color:#f2e3bf;font-size:18px;margin-top:4px}
.fee{padding:10px 0;border:0;color:#b3c6cc}
.card{background:#10283d;border:1px solid #2b5066;border-radius:17px;box-shadow:0 9px 26px #0002}
.card h2{font-size:clamp(19px,2.6vw,26px)}
.metric{background:#16364c;color:#e8f2f4;border:1px solid #2c5369;border-radius:11px}
.metric small{color:#a4c4d4}
.metric b{color:#f2d28a}
.btn{border-radius:11px;min-height:48px;border-color:#48687b;font-weight:750}
.btn.gold{background:#efc882;border-color:#efc882;color:#10273b}
.btn.green{background:#1c695a;border-color:#387f73}
.btn.danger{background:#523443;border-color:#94606c}
.btn.ghost{background:#153044;border-color:#3a6177;color:#d4e9f0}
.btn:focus-visible,.bottom button:focus-visible,.choice-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fae9b4;outline-offset:3px}
.bottom{background:#0b2236;border-color:#34536a}
.bottom .on{background:#efc882;color:#132538}
#screen{padding-top:14px}
.v11-launch{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.7fr) minmax(0,1.3fr);align-items:center;gap:0;background:#10293e;border:1px solid #335970;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 14px 34px #0003}
.launch-image{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:0;max-height:420px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 60%,#365a74,#102a3e 70%)}
.launch-image .art{max-width:100%;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:415px;object-fit:contain}
.launch-content{padding:clamp(18px,3vw,36px);min-width:0}
.launch-content h1{font-size:clamp(25px,3.3vw,45px);line-height:1.12;margin:12px 0}
.launch-content p{color:#c3d4dc;max-width:48ch;font-size:15px}
.launch-content .muted{display:block;margin-top:11px;font-size:11px}
.launch-content .actions{align-items:center}
.launch-content .actions .gold{min-width:200px}
.decision-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:15px;margin:0 0 14px}
.decision-head h1{font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,36px);margin:6px 0 4px}
.decision-head p{color:#b5cbd4;font-size:13px;margin:0}
.month-inline{border:1px solid #507184;background:transparent;border-radius:10px;color:#f0d49c;padding:12px 14px;white-space:nowrap;min-height:44px;font-size:13px;font-weight:750}
.month-inline b{font-size:18px}
.choice-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:13px;max-width:520px}
.choice-tabs button{border-radius:13px;padding:12px 15px;border:1px solid #335b72;background:#0d283e;color:#cbdce4;font-weight:780;font-size:14px;min-height:47px}
.choice-tabs button span{margin-left:5px;background:#21445b;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:15px;font-size:12px}
.choice-tabs button.chosen{border-color:#e5c181;background:#253e4b;color:#ffe4a7}
.choice-tabs button:disabled{opacity:.4}
.feature-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:46% 54%;align-items:stretch}
.feature-visual{min-height:290px;background:#122d43;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;overflow:hidden}
.feature-visual img{width:100%;height:100%;max-height:350px;object-fit:contain}
.feature-card .pad{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;padding:clamp(16px,3vw,30px)}
.feature-card .pad h2{margin-top:10px}
.feature-card .pad p{margin-top:0;color:#d6e1e5}
.feature-facts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;margin-top:5px}
.feature-facts span{display:inline-block;background:#1b4156;color:#d8e6ea;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.feature-card .actions{width:100%}
.feature-card .actions .btn{min-width:190px}
.focus-content .card>.pad{padding:20px}
.focus-content .deal-image{max-height:350px;aspect-ratio:16/8.5}
.focus-content .optional-dd{padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;margin:0;color:#bed0d9;font-size:12px}
.focus-content .optional-dd summary{color:#b1c8d5;font-weight:700}
.focus-content .optional-dd .btn{margin-top:7px;font-size:12px;min-height:38px}
.subtle-foot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:12px 0;color:#a9c3cf;font-size:12px}
.subtle-foot .btn{min-height:35px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:12px;margin-left:auto}
.fund-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(235px,1fr));gap:10px}
.fund-choice{background:#132e42;border-color:#2c4f64}
.fund-choice.active{background:#263b46;border-color:#dcbb7d}
.modal{border:1px solid #55728a;box-shadow:0 30px 90px #000a}
.modal img{max-height:500px}
.speech{background:#fff2da;color:#122a3e;line-height:1.3;font-size:18px}
.choices button{font-size:14px;line-height:1.35}
#reaction{position:fixed;z-index:8;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,20px);bottom:88px;display:none;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:min(520px,calc(100% - 25px));padding:10px;border:1px solid #e6c589;border-radius:17px;background:#122b41;color:#f4f1e5;box-shadow:0 10px 45px #0009;pointer-events:auto;opacity:0;transition:opacity .22s,transform .22s}
#reaction.visible{display:flex;opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.reaction-art{flex:0 0 98px;height:75px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:11px;background:#0c2337}
.reaction-img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.reaction-copy{flex:1;min-width:0}
.reaction-copy b{display:block;color:#f4cd84;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:3px}
.reaction-copy small{display:block;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;color:#d7e4e8}
#reaction>button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#f2d18a;font-size:25px;align-self:flex-start;padding:1px 5px}
@media(max-width:850px){.v11-launch{grid-template-columns:1fr}.launch-content{order:0;padding:18px}.launch-image{order:1;max-height:230px}.launch-image .art{max-height:220px}.feature-card{grid-template-columns:1fr}.feature-visual{min-height:0;max-height:230px}.feature-visual img{max-height:230px}.feature-card .pad{padding:17px}}

/* ODIN Nightly V11.1: actionable onboarding and a living investment skyline */
.mission-board{margin:0 0 12px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#12364b,#13334a);border:1px solid #467182;border-radius:15px;padding:12px 15px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.mission-main{min-width:0;flex:1}.mission-main b{color:#ffe2a0;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.01em}.mission-main small{display:block;color:#c7dbe4;font-size:12px;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.35}
.mission-level{font-size:12px;font-weight:850;color:#eacb8e;white-space:nowrap}.mission-track{margin-top:8px;height:6px;max-width:460px;border-radius:99px;background:#385366;overflow:hidden}.mission-track i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e6b769,#7fe3af);border-radius:99px;transition:width .35s ease}
.odin-world{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;margin:14px 0 0;border:1px solid #315b6e;border-radius:17px;padding:14px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 79% -80%,#2d6070 0,transparent 70%),linear-gradient(165deg,#102e42,#0b2035)}
.odin-world::before{content:'';position:absolute;z-index:-1;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 47px,#ffffff04 47px 48px)}
.world-heading{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}.world-heading h2{margin:0;font-size:17px}.world-heading p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:11px;color:#b3cad4}.market-badge{border-radius:40px;border:1px solid #6c8788;background:#1c4150;padding:7px 10px;color:#f4d48e;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
.world-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}.world-plot{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;overflow:hidden;min-width:0;min-height:147px;padding:11px 6px 10px;border:1px solid #436479;border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#25435a 0,#102f43 66%,#1b4750 67%,#143746 100%)}
.world-plot.filled{border-color:#b5aa70;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#335e6a 0,#15364a 66%,#32594e 67%,#1d4247 100%)}
.world-plot::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:45px;left:0;right:0;border-bottom:2px solid #d2bf8c44}.world-art{height:78px;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;transform:translateY(1px);opacity:.44;filter:grayscale(.75)}.filled .world-art{opacity:1;filter:none}.world-art svg{width:min(100%,110px);height:74px;overflow:visible;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 8px #0004)}
.world-art .lit{fill:#f6d793}.world-art .face{fill:#5b9da8}.world-art .roof{fill:#d8c298}.world-art .base{fill:#24475d}.world-art .shadow{fill:#102a3e}.world-plot.filled .lit{animation:odin-shimmer 4s ease-in-out infinite}.world-plot b{position:relative;font-size:12px;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;margin-top:6px;z-index:1}.world-plot small{position:relative;font-size:11px;color:#b9d3d9;margin-top:4px;z-index:1}
@keyframes odin-shimmer{50%{opacity:.64}}
@media(max-width:560px){.mission-board{padding:11px 12px}.mission-main small{font-size:11px}.mission-level{font-size:11px}.odin-world{padding:11px}.world-heading h2{font-size:15px}.world-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}.world-plot{min-height:132px}.world-art{height:68px}.world-art svg{height:64px}.world-plot b{font-size:12px}.world-heading p{font-size:10px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.world-plot.filled .lit{animation:none}.mission-track i{transition:none}}
:where(button,[tabindex]):focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffe9a8;outline-offset:3px}

/* V11.3: tell players exactly what each share of a commitment buys. */
.ticket-panel{background:#102e42;border:1px solid #4d7285;border-radius:13px;padding:12px;margin:14px 0 12px}.ticket-panel>strong{font-size:13px;color:#f2d295}.ticket-panel>small{display:block;color:#c7d8e0;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:7px}.ticket-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;margin:9px 0}.ticket-options button{background:#1c4155;border:1px solid #4b6d82;border-radius:9px;color:#e7f1f4;min-height:47px;padding:6px 4px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.3;touch-action:manipulation}.ticket-options button small{display:block;font-weight:500;font-size:10px;color:#b5cdd7}.ticket-options button.chosen{background:#dcb46e;color:#112c3c;border-color:#f8de9b}.ticket-options button.chosen small{color:#24445c}.ticket-options button:disabled{opacity:.45}.ticket-hint{color:#f9cb87!important}.ticket-hint.ready{color:#94e8be!important}.ticket-panel+div.actions .btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
@media(max-width:560px){.ticket-panel{padding:10px}.ticket-options button{font-size:11px}}
